key_insight: QPI-DeepONet-MAC merges physics-informed operator learning with a hybrid quantum-classical coupling to improve expressivity while preserving trainability for parametric PDEs.
engineering_relevance: The framework targets scalable, stable surrogate modeling for scientific computing workflows where accurate PDE solvers are expensive or high-dimensional.
method: Injects parameterized quantum circuits into PI-DeepONets using multiplicative-and-additive coupling (MAC) between classical features and quantum expectations.
Proves universal operator approximation capability for the hybrid architecture.
Derives gradient bounds, a trainability scaling criterion, sensor-count lower bounds, and a coherence/fidelity-based regularizer.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical guarantees and analytical bounds rather than experimental benchmark results.
watch_item: Practical performance may still depend on circuit depth, sensor availability, and controlling quantum coherence loss during training.
paper_title: QPI-DeepONet-MAC: A Scalable and Stable Hybrid Classical-Quantum Architecture for Physics-Informed Deep Operator Networks
